link.title: Integrate Bitbybit with ThreeJS
link.description: Use the Bitbybit npm packages inside a Three.js application. You get the full OCCT, JSCAD and Manifold geometry libraries as ordinary npm dependencies, plus a thin Three.js adapter that turns the resulting geometry into native meshes for your scene. These pages cover installation and project setup, a quick start that gets geometry on screen, and two worked builds: an advanced parametric model driven by a GUI, and a parametric hex house concept. Suitable if you are building your own Three.js application rather than working inside the Bitbybit editors.
